title: What If Every Chicken on Earth Vanished Tonight?

scenes.text: What if every chicken on Earth vanished tonight? The sky wouldn't change, but your kitchen would.
Chickens are the most common bird alive, over 33 billion at any moment. That's more than four per person.
The meat industry processes about 188 million chickens a day, and that supply line would stop overnight.
A 2018 census led by Ron Milo found chickens weigh a little more than double all wild birds combined.
So roughly two thirds of the weight of every bird on Earth would disappear in a single night.
Wild birds would hardly notice. But eggs, meat and the farms behind them would vanish from the world.
